workflows.content:
name: Monitor de produccion

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - Deploy Wix Production
    types:
      - completed
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: production-smoke-${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  smoke:
    name: Comprobar rutas publicas esenciales
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Esperar propagacion de produccion
        run: sleep 30

      - name: Verificar disponibilidad y contenido HTML
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          check_url() {
            local url="$1"
            local name="$2"
            local headers
            local body
            headers="$(mktemp)"
            body="$(mktemp)"

            curl \
              --fail \
              --silent \
              --show-error \
              --location \
              --max-redirs 3 \
              --connect-timeout 10 \
              --max-time 20 \
              --dump-header "$headers" \
              --output "$body" \
              "$url"

            grep -qi '^content-type: text/html' "$headers"
            test "$(wc -c < "$body")" -ge 128
            rm -f "$headers" "$body"
            echo "OK: $name"
          }

          check_url "https://www.marianmadrid.es/" "Inicio"
          check_url "https://www.marianmadrid.es/reserva-online" "Reserva online"
          check_url "https://www.marianmadrid.es/politica-privacidad-texto" "Politica de privacidad"

      - name: Nota de alerta
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "La comprobacion de produccion ha fallado. GitHub marcara esta ejecucion como fallida y notificara a los suscriptores configurados del repositorio."

name: Validate Fase 1

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: fase1-validation-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validar codigo y contratos
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Obtener codigo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Preparar Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Comprobar formato de cambios
        run: git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD

      - name: Ejecutar analisis estatico
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Ejecutar bateria de Fase 1
        run: npm test
